messages:
jen: Hotfix request — metrics-ingest (eu-west) dropping ~40% of events since 09:12 UTC. Alerts spiking, dashboards noisy. Requesting expedited deploy of 3.4.2 with migration guard and a pin for eu-west1. Can we skip canary?

matt: @jen can you paste a 1-2 line failure summary + impact? ops needs numbers to justify skip-canary.

jen: Short summary: `null pointer in aggregator` on ingest worker, backlog ~120k msgs queued, 5xx count up, latency ~3x. Affects billing pipelines and SLOs. Need to reduce blast radius but move fast.

luis: If backlog is that big, skipping canary is reasonable. Need rollback plan, pinning, and KV cache warmup steps.

marie: oncall here, +1 for expedited. I want rollback guard and a 2h pin window. Prefer gradual jump to 25% then full if stable.

samir: Logs show malformed proto from Kafka consumer on a subset of partitions — patch in 3.4.2 addresses parsing pre-checks.

matt: OK. Approvals required: @luis + @marie to skip canary. @deploy-bot can you surface preflight/canary health for 3.4.2?

deploy-bot: Canary health check: build 3.4.2 (#356) — unit tests: pass, integration: partial, perf: nominal. No prod traffic yet. Canary window: none.

luis: APPROVE skip-canary. I'll watch KV cache and partition skew during rollout. Pin eu-west1 -> 3.4.2 for 2h.

marie: APPROVE. I'll hold pager for the window and monitor alerts.

matt: Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/rel/3.4.2 — includes null pointer fix, proto validation, and a migration guard that can revert incomplete shards. Observers: @luis @marie @samir.

jen: Deploy snippet to kick off (run via deploy-bot):
```
deploy --service metrics-ingest --version 3.4.2 --region eu-west1 --pin-duration 2h --skip-canary --migration-guard=true
```

deploy-bot: Received deploy request. Running preflight checks.

deploy-bot: Preflight OK. Starting deploy to eu-west1 in skip-canary mode. Pinning route and doing a soft incremental jump (25% then 100%) as mitigation.

deploy-bot: Progress: 25% -> 3.4.2 (10/40 hosts) :eyes:

marie: seeing lower error rate on the updated hosts, backlog decreasing on those partitions.

deploy-bot: Progress: 100% -> 3.4.2. Post-deploy checks running (5m).

deploy-bot: Post-deploy: ingest rate normalized, backlog draining, 5xx spike cleared. Locking pin until 2h or manual unpin.

matt: Good. Rollback steps if we see regression: `deploy --service metrics-ingest --version 3.4.1 --region eu-west1 --force-rollback` then `unpin --service metrics-ingest --region eu-west1`. Keep timeline in thread.

jen: I'll monitor metrics and alerts for the next 1h, will escalate if anything trends up.

samir: Marking this expedited-hotfix as resolved for now. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
